cropSystems.label: Oil palm — immature (years 0 to 3)
cropSystems.notes: PORIM-recommended four-species mix. Standard for new oil palm plantings on lowland tropical soils.

cropSystems.label: Oil palm — mature (years 4+)
cropSystems.notes: Mucuna bracteata monoculture is the standard for mature oil palm due to shade tolerance and deep rooting.

cropSystems.label: Rubber — young (years 0 to 3)
cropSystems.notes: PORIM four-species mix at slightly lower rate. RRIM-validated for young rubber.

cropSystems.label: Rubber — mature (tapping phase)
cropSystems.notes: Mucuna-led with Centrosema secondary. Manage Mucuna away from tapping panels.

cropSystems.label: Fruit tree (durian, mango, mangosteen, citrus, generic)
cropSystems.notes: Lighter mix for fruit orchard ground cover. Adjust for canopy shade as trees mature.

cropSystems.label: Smallholder mixed perennial / annual
cropSystems.notes: Budget mix for smallholder use. Lower cost; expects reseeding effort.

fertilizerOffset.notes: 1 kg N approx 2.17 kg urea (100/46). Multiply fixed N by 2.17, then by urea price, then by efficiency factor 0.7 to estimate year-one fertilizer offset value.
